text: {"summary":"The payments-gitops repo scan shows hardcoded secrets committed in the working tree: an AWS access key ID in config/prod.env (trivy fs CRITICAL, also flagged by kubescape C-0012) and a private key at deploy/tls/key.pem (trivy fs HIGH). Kubescape reports NSA at 90.0 and MITRE at 95.0. One low-severity misconfiguration (KSV-0014) was found in deploy/api.yaml. No image or dependency vulnerabilities were reported, and no clusters were scanned. Node/control-plane checks and git history were not assessed.","targets":["payments-gitops"],"frameworks":[{"name":"NSA","passed":20,"failed":2,"skipped":4,"score":90.0},{"name":"MITRE","passed":17,"failed":1,"skipped":4,"score":95.0}],"findings":[{"severity":"CRITICAL","title":"AWS access key ID committed in production config file","resource":"config/prod.env","controls":["C-0012","aws-access-key-id"],"evidence":"trivy fs flagged an aws-access-key-id (CRITICAL) in config/prod.env, and kubescape control C-0012 (HIGH) reports credentials in configuration files for 1 resource, example config/prod.env.","fix":"Revoke/rotate the key in AWS IAM now, then remove it from the file and load it from a secret store: `git rm --cached config/prod.env && echo config/prod.env >> .gitignore` and use SealedSecrets/External Secrets/SOPS for the value. Because the digest does not scan git history, also check history and purge it (e.g. git filter-repo) after rotation."},{"severity":"HIGH","title":"Private key committed in repository","resource":"deploy/tls/key.pem","controls":["private-key"],"evidence":"trivy fs flagged a private-key (HIGH) in deploy/tls/key.pem.","fix":"Treat the key as compromised: reissue the certificate with a new key, remove the file (`git rm deploy/tls/key.pem`), add `*.pem` to .gitignore, and deliver the key via a Kubernetes Secret managed by SealedSecrets/External Secrets/cert-manager."},{"severity":"LOW","title":"Root filesystem not read-only","resource":"deploy/api.yaml","controls":["KSV-0014"],"evidence":"trivy config reports KSV-0014 (LOW) for deploy/api.yaml; the misconfig count for LOW is 3 but the digest lists only this one item.","fix":"In the container spec add: securityContext:\n  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true\n(mount emptyDir volumes for any paths that need writes)."}],"not_checked":[{"item":"node and control-plane CIS checks","reason":"need a privileged node-collector pod; the audit identity is read-only"},{"item":"git history","reason":"secrets removed from history are not scanned"},{"item":"Remaining 2 LOW trivy config misconfigurations","reason":"misconfig_counts shows LOW: 3 but the digest details only one (KSV-0014)"},{"item":"Second failed NSA control","reason":"NSA reports 2 failed controls but the digest lists only C-0012 under failed_controls"},{"item":"Live cluster state","reason":"the digest contains no cluster data (clusters is empty), so RBAC, Argo CD and runtime posture were not assessed"}]}
